plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'CIS: Computer Networking Management A.S. Degree - CISCO (Full Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 08, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7300/PublishedPdf), GE Pattern: local AA/AS, Start Term: Fall. Total Units 60 = 16+14.5+16+13.5 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). Elective courses: any elective courses numbered 100-499, or having a 4-digit number starting with C. Scheduling: CISN 340 is offered the 1st 8 weeks and CISN 341 the 2nd 8 weeks so they can be taken in the same semester; CISC 323 is offered the 1st 8 weeks and CISC 324 the 2nd 8 weeks so they can be taken in the same semester; CISC 350 and 361 are offered in the 1st 8 weeks. Students can substitute ESLW 340 for ENGL C1000/C1000H. Per map: at the end of the second semester, students qualify for the CIS: Computer Networking Management certificate with a CISCO concentration. This CISCO-concentration degree covers all objectives of the Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification exam.
